content_plan.hero_tagline: A word that moved from seclusion to rights, then into information.
content_plan.chart01_intro: Before privacy became a legal or digital issue, it moved through older fields of seclusion, secrecy, private life, and freedom from observation.

limitations: This layer is not a first-attestation layer.
Pre-1800 Ngram values are treated as visual-directional signals because sparse early book data can create spikes.
The 1890 marker is a legal-semantic threshold, not the origin of privacy as a word.
The visual should show weak pre-modern change rather than claiming a sharp pre-industrial rupture.
